SUSPECTED LOW-MEDIUM, non-blocking, candidate for its own task (pre-existing since 2cf546a, not introduced by the fixes): the mirror increments enviados at core send() acceptance (adaptador.rs, before the IPC write) whereas Go's transmisorObservado calls ObservarEnvio only on a successful transmit. A message the outbox later exhausts ('fallido') or hard-discards on TTL depresses that contact's ratio in Rust but not in Go, so a prolonged sidecar/WhatsApp outage could raise one false caida_acuses alert per contact messaged during it; in the AC's motivating scenario (blocked contact) both mirrors agree. Suggested shape: open the join at send(), increment enviados on the 'enviado' ack, keep acusados on entregado/leido.

SUSPECTED LOW, non-blocking, candidate for the same follow-up: since 'enviado' no longer drains mensajes_en_vuelo, joins for never-delivered messages persist until the 1024 cap, where registrar_envio clears the whole map, so healthy contacts' later 'entregado' cannot be resolved and their ratio undercounts. Go evicts oldest-first (desalojarCorrelacion). Remote at a micro-business cell's volume.
